periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Piloted a Know Your Body unit in two elementary schools. Adult weekday sessions at the library drew few people, holding completions to 220. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Parks/Rec/Libraries.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add an evening adult session at Riverside Library and develop large-print materials for older residents.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Added an evening adult session at Riverside Library and expanded the school unit, and completions reached 390, which brings the strategy back on pace. Drafted large-print materials with the Housing Authority. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harborview Housing Authority.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Deliver the Know Your Body unit in grades 3 to 5, continue Riverside Library sessions, and bring large-print sessions to senior housing.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Delivered a school-based Know Your Body unit for grades 3 to 5, adult sessions at Riverside Library and large-print materials for older residents at senior housing. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harborview Housing Authority.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Evaluate comprehension with a brief teach-back check and adapt the older adult session for a video format.
